headline: Disney's strong quarter driven by 'Toy Story 5' and the draw of its US theme parks
summary: Disney's solid third quarter was driven by a $1 billion box office haul from “Toy Story 5” and the strong draw of U.S. theme parks that helped to offset continued weakness from international tourism. headline: Disney Climbs on Profit Beat; AMD Falls on Underwhelming Forecast | Stock Movers

President Harley Finkelstein said it was a "monster quarter" for the company.

content.title: Disney Climbs on Profit Beat; AMD Falls on Underwhelming Forecast | Stock Movers
content.description:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are lower after the semiconductor firm's second-quarter revenue and third-quarter sales forecast underwhelmed investors expecting a stronger performance given rising demand. 
- Disney (DIS) shares are climbing as profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company's fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida.
- Shopify (SHOP) shares are soaring after it reported revenue for the second quarter that beat the average analyst estimate. President Harley Finkelstein said it was a "monster quarter" for the company.

headline: How Disney's IP Strategy Is Driving Growth
